contracts.stage: Executed; construction and project financing pending
contracts.current_timing: H1 CY2028; permitting and utility arrangements outstanding
contracts.recognition: Base contract value $5.4bn. Recognition and billings phase in on delivery. Exclude renewal options and do not add to the pre-November payment schedule.

contracts.description: Delta Forge 2 base lease covers 210 MW
contracts.recognition: This June lease is included in the August lessor minimum schedule.

contracts.description: Initial tranche of a North Dakota campus
contracts.original_timing: First 50 MW by end of CY2026
contracts.current_timing: 25 MW ready per November 24 update. Remaining commissioning drives the year-end 300 MW portfolio target.
contracts.recognition: Readiness does not by itself establish recognized quarterly rent.

valuation.reason: Lease payments and parent free cash flow have different timing and claims.
valuation.basis: Cash flows attributable to parent common after debt, preferred and minority claims. No external consensus is authenticated in this edition.

financing.reason: No verified 12- or 24-month all-in construction spend, committed draw schedule and freely distributable cash by project.

ownership_audit.history: Current five-session comparison uses the USD Nasdaq listing. Close and adjusted close agree on its two endpoints. The full historical corporate-action series remains unaudited.
ownership_audit.corporate_actions: 1-for-6 common reverse split April 12, 2022. Series G capacity increased in November 2026.
ownership_audit.dilution: Conversion ratio depends on the terms of future puts. Macquarie senior distributions and minority economics separately reduce common value.

report.thesis: Quarter-end project cash and contracted rent are substantial. The amount available to APLD common still depends on construction costs, debt service and Macquarie preferred distributions.
catalysts: Remaining 25 MW against year-end delivery schedule.
Project financing targeted Q1 CY2027 at Delta Forge 1 and Polaris Forge 3.
risks: Preferred conversion and project cash restrictions.
Renewal options inflate headline lease value.
invalidation: Tenant delivery slips or project financing requires material equity.
missing: Common-holder cash waterfall, parent-only liquidity and actual Series G issuance.
